reference.label: Research Median AWD Hot Hatch

semantic_surface_implicit_alignment.basis: bidirectional nearest-triangle distance between independently tessellated final surfaces

reference.panel_model_status: semantic masks; exclusive domain partition deferred

occupant_containment.basis: independent final-mesh ray parity and triangle distance
occupant_containment.model: four torso ellipsoids plus four head ellipsoids

wheel_envelope_clearance.basis: sampled tyre surface over declared steer and suspension poses against final mesh

V0.meaning: finite framed parameter model and acyclic DAG

V2.meaning: package, semantic surface, exclusive partition and scaffold alignment

V3.meaning: sampled concept suspension, tyre, closure and helical-glass kinematics

V4.meaning: manufacturing and structural engineering not claimed

V5.meaning: CFD, crash, homologation and physical validation not claimed

assurance.boundary: V3 is concept-level sampled kinematic assurance, not production mechanism approval.

projection.method: bracketed radial solve to implicit outer scaffold

compound_closure_notes.rear_hatch: outer semantic skin may contain left/right components; a production inner frame is deferred

suspension_hardpoint_model.assurance_note: Concept hardpoints and gain-based pose solver; not measured production suspension geometry.

actual_tyre_pose_sweeps.sweep_geometry: convex hull of all transformed actual tyre vertices
actual_tyre_pose_sweeps.clearance_basis: nearest final-body triangles plus sparse final-mesh ray parity

closure_kinematics.basis: transformed closure triangles versus independent fixed-body aperture surface

helical_glass_kinematics.assurance_note: Guide motion is parametric and cavity-based; no regulator hardware or production glass-drop study is claimed.
